name: Walker's Court
text: Walker's Court is a pedestrian alleyway in the Soho district of the City of Westminster, London. The passage dates from around the early 1700s and escaped modernisation in the late nineteenth century so that it retains its original narrow layout. In the twentieth century the small shops that traded from the alley gradually closed and from the late 1950s the alley became associated with Soho's sex trade.

depictions.name: Walker's Court
depictions.text: is a location in Watch Dogs: Legion, in the City of Westminster.
